sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Cute Bow Knot CZ Gold-Plated Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Product Description:
Show off playful elegance with the Cute Bow Knot CZ Gold-Plated Ring for Women. Featuring a charming bow-knot motif adorned with glittering CZ stones on a sleek gold-plated band, this ring is pure delight. The adorable yet stylish design of the Cute Bow Knot CZ Gold-Plated Ring for Women makes it perfect for adding sparkle to any outfit or gifting a special someone.
Why You Will Love It:
✨ Sweet bow knot design for a touch of whimsy
✨ Pavé CZ stones create glamorous, eye-catching sparkle
✨ Adjustable fit ensures maximum comfort
✨ Ideal for parties, daily wear, or gifting loved ones
Highlights / Specifications:
🔹 Material: Premium, durable alloy
🔹 Plating: Rich gold plating for lasting brilliance
🔹 Stone Type: High-quality pavé set cubic zirconia
🔹 Design: Cute bow-knot motif with sparkling accents
🔹 Size/Fit: Adjustable for most finger sizes
🔹 Best Use: Perfect for daily wear, party wear, and heartfelt gifting
Care Instructions:
💎 Clean gently with a microfiber or polishing cloth
🚫 Avoid chemicals, water, and ultrasonic cleaners
🛑 Remove while swimming, showering, or gardening
🌡️ Store in a cool, dry place away from extreme temperatures
Perfect For:
🎁 Gifting on Weddings, Birthdays, Valentine's Day, Festivals
👭 Teen girls, daughters, sisters, and fashion-forward women
💃 Matching with western and ethnic outfits for a glam touch
